title: Discogs Wantlist to Purchase Conversion
dataSources: Discogs collection entries (`discogs:item`), comics (`comic:item`), coin catalogue entries (`coin:item`), stamp album entries (`stamp:item`), and watch logs (`watch:item`).
app: Collection telemetry from Discogs, Comic Vine, coin and stamp catalogues, and watch-collection trackers sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=discogs:item
| search wantlist=true
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as attempts count(eval(purchased="true")) as successful by _time genre
| eval success_pct=if(attempts>0,round(100*successful/attempts,1),0)
| sort - _time
description: Tracks success rate for Discogs wantlist items by genre.
value: Wantlist conversion shows whether the saved targets are realistically moving into the shelf.
implementation: Capture explicit outcome states for Discogs wantlist items events in `index=personal` and review both attempts and success percentage over time.
visualization: Time chart of success percentage for Discogs wantlist items by genre.
grandmaExplanation: It records how often Discogs wantlist items works the way you expect instead of quietly failing.
